scope.inventory: Explicitly enumerated syntax and built-in members; not an exhaustive ECMA-262 inventory. Adding a method or syntax form requires adding/updating its entry.
scope.test262: Every group and capability is unqualified by a whole-feature corpus run; focused upstream suite records are separate evidence and never upgraded to whole-feature pass.

components.rationale: Runtime tracing GC is integrated; independent weak/ephemeron primitives do not expose WeakRef or FinalizationRegistry.
Rust Map/Set iteration and weak-key helpers are tested independently. Missing JS prototype methods above remain unimplemented.
Rust typed views, detachment and species helpers do not establish complete JS typed-array constructors or Array.prototype.slice.
Host Promise state and async-produced thenables exist; they do not connect the global Promise placeholder constructor/prototype to complete Promise semantics.
An unconfigured Rust host provider boundary exists; no Intl JavaScript namespace is installed.

Host ModuleGraph exercises actual linking and evaluation. Script probes do not execute module source; dynamic import and pending top-level await remain incomplete. Named indirect exports are checked at link time, with cached failures before body execution.

Public Engine-backed CLI and Executor run actual parse/link/evaluate phases with fresh Realms, unchanged harness sources and strict/raw/quoted-list handling. Original CLI cases and all 30 prior #146 dependency files are tested. The real $262 realm/evalScript/detach/gc hooks are connected. All executable variants have supervised Linux workers with finite wall, address-space/RSS and stack bounds. Host resource failures remain distinct from language negatives. Corpus baselines and whole-suite qualification remain separate.

Real child Realms, ScriptRecord evalScript completions, ArrayBuffer detachment and Engine collection are installed per execution with weak callbacks and externally rooted Realm handles. Cross-Realm identity, detached runtime-view reads/writes and immutable original cases are tested. Integer TypedArray/SharedArrayBuffer globals, broader DataView methods and unpaired UTF-16 Script source remain unqualified; no whole-host API conformance claim.

The actual CLI loads the original doneprintHandle harness, drives shared Agent jobs and distinguishes completion, rejection, duplicates and missing completion. A worker supervisor enforces finite async deadlines including infinite bodies/jobs. Original pinned return/throw cases pass in AST and Auto. Global Promise APIs, broader async conformance remain unqualified; general Linux process bounds are recorded separately.

The real CLI uses canonical corpus-relative fixture resolution, preserves dependency identities and rejects lossy UTF-16 path aliases. Module linking validates indirect re-exports before body execution. Original cyclic/missing-export/basic-await cases are executed at the fixed corpus pin; broader instantiation and TLA failures remain recorded. Pending async module graphs and incomplete globals/namespace behavior are not qualified.

Linux CLI runs each executable variant in a fresh child with finite deadline, pre-exec address-space/stack limits, RSS monitoring and a zero core-file limit. Actual timeout, stack/allocation exhaustion, fatal signals, global/job isolation and ordinary negative cases are tested. Host failures cannot satisfy JavaScript negatives. Parent corpus metadata loading, non-Linux resource enforcement and general security sandboxing are not qualified.

Real CLI metadata-only indexing and isolated execution capture per-feature outcomes with overlapping tags, untagged cases, timeout separation and explicit not-run/unreported coverage. Snapshots retain raw reports and corpus/manifest/binary/selection identities. Authored and fixed-revision captures are distinguished; metadata errors retain unknown variant counts. Reporting does not qualify full feature support or regression selection.

Actual pinned Engine captures feed an independently verified per-variant comparison. Known-pass failures/timeouts, missing results and unexplained new skips fail; policy changes require fresh reasons. Full-run shards cover each file once. Stable/MSRV focused CLI integration and a production PR run of128files214variants retain raw evidence. PR selection uses the verified full baseline, and the weekly workflow partitions every eligible file into eight jobs. Whole-corpus compatibility is not qualified.

Actual public Engine and pinned native SpiderMonkey workers compare typed completions, exception types, ordered side effects and native jobs. Raw bytes, executable identities and exact known-difference reproducers remain recorded. Native runs include five unchanged original Test262 variants in both modes; unsupported values, accessor snapshots and infrastructure faults never count as equal passes. General exotic object semantics, whole-corpus conformance and performance superiority remain unqualified.
